notes:
Top-line: enterprise research portal for fixed-income and macro research. Primary ask: scale embeddings + reranking across 100M+ docs with EU data residency controls and BYOK KMS. Prefer Redwood Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation.

Key constraints / quotes: "We need p50 <150ms for user queries and p95 <350ms including reranker — anywhere above that damages adoption." Strong emphasis on cost-per-query; procurement target ~ <$0.01/query across full pipeline (ANN + cross-encoder rerank).

Architecture preference: two-stage retrieval (ANN index + GPU cross-encoder rerank). Want automatic prefix/KV cache for query-heavy corpora; reuse for daily market updates. Expect ~120M articles/notes (~400M embeddings with chunking). Vector dim estimates: 1536/2048 depending on model. Reranker budget: reserve dedicated GPU pool (quantized cross-encoder).

Security/compliance: BYOK (HSM/KMS), SSO via SAML + SCIM provisioning, audit logging to SIEM, retention controls per legal hold. EU clients require data residency in eu-west-1 for a subset of indexes.

Commercial: leaning dedicated monthly commit (3-12 months) but wants canary fallback to hosted for burst. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching/quantization) to meet cost targets.

Quote from CTO on demo call: "Accuracy gains from reranker are necessary, but we won't accept exponential cost increases — need suggestions that hit both quality and cost."

Useful artifacts: security questionnaire submitted (SEC-2241), sample index export provided via S3 link (internal), initial capacity spreadsheet attached in Drive.

AE notes: strong exec sponsorship, procurement cycle Q2, legal already flagged BYOK & data residency as gating items. Seeding POC with 5M docs next 4 weeks to validate p95.
